lines.en: He's got to really give her a reason, you know?
Maybe he could slip her the tongue.
Or maybe he could grab her and lift her up.
Yeah, yeah, and then Adrian, maybe she could wrap her legs around his waist.
And then she could rip off his shirt and kiss his chest and his stomach.
And then he could use his teeth, his teeth, to undo her dress and, and, and bite her.
And then right, right when the scene ends, he could take her with this raw animal.
Yeah, that's pretty much what I had in mind.
